Name: More Animals
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[center]﻿With the introduction of 1.6 all the functionality of this mod is now available through Vanilla.
Because of this, the mod has been discontinued.

I thank everyone for their support while this mod was active![/center]


This mod lets you to get more pets, and optionally randomises the appearance of your farm animals based on the sprites you download.

[b]As of 1.4 something has changed in SDV's code which causes pets to get stuck on eachother, until I have time to fix it, you can use this mod to do so: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5986]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5986[/url][/b]


[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url].[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b]Use[/b]
See [url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/tree/master/MoreAnimals#use]the readme for info about using the mod[/url].


[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.32 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player (multiplayer not supported in 3.0+).
[/list]
[/list]

[b]See also[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/blob/master/MoreAnimals/RELEASE-NOTES.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods]Source code[/url]
[*][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-more-animals.125946/]Support thread[/url] (make sure you include your [url=https://log.smapi.io/]latest SMAPI log[/url] when asking for help!)
[*][url=https://www.patreon.com/entoarox]Consider supporting Entoarox on Patreon[/url]
[/list]
